mapper.select: SELECT a.NAME FROM ALARM_REPOSITORY a JOIN ALARM_EVENT c ON a.id = c.REPOSITORY_ID JOIN ALARM_EVENT_REL b ON c.ID = b.EVENT_ID WHERE b.ALARM_ID = #{alarmId} GROUP BY a.NAME
select * from ALARM_REPOSITORY where ALARM_CODE = #{uniqueCode} and REGEXP_INSTR(#{originalMsg}, STATUS_FLAG) > 0
select id, type_alias as name, event_category from alarm_event_type where asset_desks like #{assetDesk} and event_category is not null
